vibe_rationale: Curation-led indie brand with strong taste credentials, but a racetrack-scale site and global headliners push it towards mass market.
fit_notes: Large music audience (age not captured) with weak wellness adjacency, so this is a reach play more than a community play. The 120,000 figure is the 2022 first-edition organiser count including city shows, so scale is dated. Two presenting brands and several majors in 2023, but no 2026 sponsor list and no partnership page. Brazil-based.
